recognize_zh: 背景小至中型淋巴球之間散佈許多大細胞，細胞質在固定後收縮成透亮空腔、核呈多葉狀，典型的腔隙細胞（lacunar cell）；右上方另見一個核濃縮深染、周圍有空暈的木乃伊細胞（mummified cell），提示結節硬化型古典何杰金淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous large lacunar cells with retracted, clear to finely vacuolated cytoplasm sitting in empty spaces
Lacunar cell nuclei are lobulated/folded with delicate chromatin and small nucleoli
Occasional mummified (apoptotic) HRS cell with a condensed, hyperchromatic nucleus in a clear halo
Background of small to medium lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei
Thin strands of eosinophilic collagen between cell groups
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a cellular infiltrate in which numerous large lacunar cells are distributed among a background of small to medium lymphocytes, with thin collagen strands. The lacunar cells have abundant retracted, clear cytoplasm and lobulated nuclei with small nucleoli; a mummified cell with a condensed hyperchromatic nucleus is also present. Sheets of monomorphic large atypical cells or necrosis are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: ALCL forms cohesive sheets of hallmark cells with horseshoe nuclei and is CD30+/ALK+ or ALK- with T-cell antigens and no CD15, rather than scattered lacunar cells in a reactive background.
LP (popcorn) cells lack the retraction artifact of lacunar cells and are CD20+/CD45+, CD30-/CD15-, in a nodular small B-cell background without collagen bands.
Its scattered large cells are CD20+ B cells in a T-cell and histiocyte background, without lacunar retraction or sclerosis.
Metastases form cohesive clusters and are keratin or S100/SOX10 positive, whereas HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ and keratin negative.
